CHIEF COMPLAINT
Follow-up evaluation status post mitral valve repair.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Melissa Sanchez is a 63-year-old female presenting for follow-up care following mitral valve repair performed on 8/3/2020. Patient reports feeling significantly better since surgery. She continues to experience occasional chest discomfort and shallow breathing with exertion, which resolves after a few minutes of rest. Episodes occur approximately a couple of times per month. Patient reports taking her medications regularly with the aid of a reminder app and denies new concerning symptoms. She notes initial irritability with atenolol that has since resolved. Recent ECG from 12/26/2020 shows atrial fibrillation with controlled ventricular response and anterior T-wave inversions without significant change compared to previous study.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Patient denies new symptoms. Continues to experience episodic chest discomfort and dyspnea with exertion that resolves with rest. Denies palpitations, syncope, orthopnea, or lower extremity edema.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
Mitral regurgitation
Atrial fibrillation
Diabetes mellitus
Asthma
Recurrent chest discomfort with negative cardiac workup for coronary artery disease
Status post mitral valve repair (8/3/2020)

MEDICATIONS
Coumadin 4 mg daily
Lasix 4 mg daily
Atenolol 50 mg daily

ALLERGIES
Not documented.

FAMILY HISTORY
Not documented.

SOCIAL HISTORY
Not documented.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
General: Well-appearing female in no acute distress.
Head and Neck: No jugular venous distention.
Lungs: Reduced breath sounds with clear auscultation and percussion.
Heart: Irregularly irregular rhythm consistent with atrial fibrillation. S1 slightly accentuated, no S3 gallop.
Abdomen: Soft, non-tender.
Extremities: Trace peripheral edema noted bilaterally.

RESULTS
ECG (12/26/2020): Atrial fibrillation with controlled ventricular response. Anterior T-wave inversion. No significant changes compared to previous study.

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
63-year-old female with history of mitral regurgitation and atrial fibrillation status post mitral valve repair in 2020, presenting for follow-up. Patient recovering well from surgery with well-controlled atrial fibrillation on current medication regimen. Cardiac examination reveals well-functioning heart valves with expected irregularly irregular rhythm. Continue current medications: Coumadin 4 mg daily, Lasix 4 mg daily, and Atenolol 50 mg daily. Encouraged patient to remain active as tolerated and to continue monitoring activity level based on symptom tolerance. Follow-up appointment in 6-9 months.
